name: listTickets
description: List service tickets, newest first, with queue code and assignee. status: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED or empty for all. Page with limit/offset and always check hasMore.

name: getTicket
description: Fetch one ticket by reference (for example TKT-1001). Returns an envelope with at most one item.

name: getTicketSummary
description: Counts of open, high-priority and unassigned tickets. Bare object with no items/hasMore envelope.

name: assignTickets
description: Assign tickets to an engineer. references must be a JSON array string such as ["TKT-1001"]. Returns updated_count and updated/skipped references. Changes data: call only after the user confirms.
